summary: Examples of yum_repository: adding EPEL, putting multiple repos in one file, removing a repo with a handler to clean metadata, and removing from a specific file.
questions: How do I add the EPEL repository?
How do I put two repos in one file?
How do I remove a repo and clean metadata?

answer_card.title: yum_repository examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.yum_repository:
    name: epel
    description: EPEL YUM repo
    baseurl: https://download.fedoraproject.org/pub/epel/$releasever/$basearch/
- ansible.builtin.yum_repository:
    name: rpmforge
    description: RPMforge YUM repo
    file: external_repos
    mirrorlist: http://mirrorlist.repoforge.org/el7/mirrors-rpmforge
    enabled: no
- ansible.builtin.yum_repository: {name: epel, state: absent}
  notify: yum-clean-metadata   # handler: command: yum clean metadata
- ansible.builtin.yum_repository: {name: epel, file: external_repos, state: absent}
```
